product_metadata.title: Deep South Barrels 1-Liter American White Oak Barrel Bourbon Kit
features: TRUSTED BARREL BRAND - Brew Naturally Kit featuring Deep South Barrels American White Oak Barrel for Aging. Age your own Bourbon, Whiskey, Rum, Tequila, Beer and Wine
BARREL AGING STARTER KIT - Kit includes 1-liter barrel, bung, spigot, barrel stand, 2 bottles Bourbon essence (please note, essence container may vary) and instructions

SATISFACTION GUARANTEE - Our barrels are handcrafted by a cooper (barrel maker) and then cured (sealed) the first time by you, the user. Any leaks or other issues within the first 90 days, we will replace your barrel at no cost, please contact us. Brew Naturally Instructions Included

PREMIUM QUALITY AMERICAN WHITE OAK - Charred on the inside with a Medium Char (we find this to be the most universal for aging spirits), from wood sources across the continental US including California, Missouri and Kentucky

HIGHEST QUALITY CRAFTSMANSHIP - Handcrafted, finished on the outside, with black steel bands. Just like full size barrels, our barrels are held together by pressure of the wood and the metal bands surrounding the barrel. Please follow the instructions for curing your barrel, and enjoy
description: Brew Naturally 1-Liter American White Oak aging barrel kit. Each kit includes one 1-liter barrel charred on the inside with a medium char, bung, spigot, barrel stand, two bottles of Bourbon Essence flavor (neutral spirit not included) and Brew Naturally LLC instructions. This barrel can also be used for aging Whiskey, Rum, Tequila, Beer and Wine. Beverages aged in wooden barrels take on some of the compounds in the barrel such as the vanillin and wood tannins. As the barrel “breathes” the alcohol passes back and forth through the charring causing the impurities to be filtered out into the wood leaving you with a smoother end result. Enjoy!
